notes.title: v0.19 - Food update preview!
notes.notes:
v0.19 is released!

I would like to showcase the first preview of the food update. I have decided to show an early experimental preview of it, and you can test it out by enabling it in the main menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/f81d2c118aacdf4828722af391847e6e848128a1.png

When enabled, the food feature will be enabled in your game. This must be enabled manually each time the game starts up.

New Food Buildings
New buildings will be added: Farms, Biolabs, Fishing Huts, as well as new food resources!

The farm produces vegetables. In the future, farms will only be buildable on fertile soil found on mountainous islands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/b3804cd377f0ff585d9888949ffe868d483c1b66.png

Vegetables won't be enough after awhile. Your workforce will want more food variety after awhile. When you have underwater unlocked, you can build Fishing Huts to get Fish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/318164ce4fd082ed2c62b12e689934721fe085c1.png

Getting more food variety will provide productivity bonuses - occasionally alien meat will drop from destroyed ships. You can't eat them, but they can be processed in biolabs to be turned into edible, yummy alien meat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/6bd9de7ab9358b8d087823f17bcef03562e43df1.png

Improvements have also been made in other areas.

Full v0.19 changelog:

Add experimental food feature: Toggled in main menu
Increase camera's max zoom
Fix HP bars appearing at screen corner when enemy spawns
Change perks UI to prepare for Perks Update

Let me know if you get to try the update!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/07da4d9d6f461d441e89fcdb3044adcd64037b05.png

notes.title: Demo release in 10 days!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I would like to announce the release date of Last Fuse's demo!
Launching on Steam April 4, 2pm UTC!

I've always wanted to make a tower defense game, and I'm excited to flesh this out into something you'll all enjoy! Last Fuse was born out of a game jam that took place in late February, according to the theme "Nothing can go wrong". My ideation process in detail here.

Building a bomb in the middle of a city, protecting it from alien invasions, while it's on the verge of meltdown? What can go wrong?

An exciting roadmap is in the works, and I'll reveal it at the end of this week—stay tuned!

Join the Last Fuse Discord to share feedback (if you've tried it on itch.io), discuss the game, and chat with fellow players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531310/dcd2bc34e1cb4e324d2f890bb25ab4ed54c27c4b.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558060/Last_Fuse/

Look forward to sharing the game with you all!
-YYZ
